description:
Introducing the Eskute NOVA RR Electric Dirt Bike – Engineered for Unstoppable Performance.

Combining a massive 5500W peak motor with aggressive styling, the NOVA RR is built to dominate the most demanding off-road terrains. It empowers riders to push their limits with explosive acceleration while maintaining superior stability and control.

Experience the pinnacle of electric motocross with the NOVA RR. Designed for experienced riders who crave speed and raw power, this e-dirt bike transforms rugged mountain trails and uneven landscapes into your personal playground. Whether you are tackling steep climbs or racing across open fields, the NOVA RR delivers professional-grade thrills wherever the ride takes you.

Dominate the terrain with a high-output motor that delivers responsive torque and substantial peak power. This system provides strong acceleration and consistent power response, giving you the confidence to conquer steep slopes and challenging recreational applications with ease.

Powered by a premium 60V 30Ah Battery (1800Wh), the NOVA RR offers a substantial energy reserve for extended riding sessions. This high-capacity battery supports the high-output power system, ensuring you can explore further without range anxiety. (Note: Actual range varies with speed, rider weight, terrain, temperature, and operating conditions.)

Capable of reaching speeds ranging from 35 to 50 MPH under applicable operating conditions, this electric motorcycle provides a higher-performance riding platform for adrenaline seekers. The instant throttle response ensures you have the explosive speed needed for extreme off-road adventures. (Actual speed depends on rider weight, terrain, battery charge, and other operating conditions.)

Ride with confidence knowing you have Full Suspension (front and rear) that absorbs impacts and manages wheel movement over uneven terrain, helping maintain chassis stability. The bike rolls on aggressive Fat Tires with a 17" front and 14" rear wheel setup, providing a substantial contact area and planted chassis feel for maximum traction and directional stability across varied surfaces.

Stay in control with the intuitive interface tracking your speed and battery life in real-time. The bike arrives mostly pre-assembled with illustrated instructions—simply attach the remaining parts using the step-by-step guide, and you are ready to ride in no time.

Ride Fast. Ride Wild. Ride with Eskute NOVA RR.
